jobs.description:
Job Description and Responsibilities

Become part of one of the largest and fastest-growing privately held security companies in the U.S! Since 1998, Sunstates Security has built a national reputation for delivering exceptional services while fostering high-quality work environments for our team. We are dedicated to hiring, developing, and retaining a professional workforce that reflects our commitment to excellence.

We believe in strategic reinvestment in our people by offering a benefits package that exceeds industry standards, pathways for career advancement, extensive internal training, and employee recognition programs. Our team members are provided with the tools, knowledge, and hands-on management support necessary for long-term success.

Our commitment to a superior workplace culture is reflected in our most recent national accolades. Sunstates Security is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Forbes Dream Employer, an honor based on independent employee feedback and workplace excellence. Additionally, we have been named a 2026 Training MVP by Training Magazine, marking the third consecutive year we have accepted this prestigious recognition. We also continue to be celebrated for our steady growth and stability on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

At the heart of everything we do are our core values of honor, integrity, and trust. If you are searching for a rewarding career with a proactive security partner that protects some of the country’s leading organizations, we invite you to explore the possibilities at Sunstates Security. Join a successful, growing team where your talent is appreciated and have opportunities to advance your professional career.

HIRING IMMEDIATELY     

Sunstates Security is hosting a Hiring Event for Security Officers on Tuesday, August 18, 2026 from 9:00AM - 2:00PM

Meet with Hiring Managers to explore Full-Time, Part-Time, and Flex positions on 1st, 2nd, and 3rd shifts in the Houston, Texas area.

Various days and shifts are available with a pay range of $16.00 - $17.00/hr, with weekly pay.

Location of event:

Houston Branch Office

8300 Cypress Creek Pkwy

Houston Texas 77070

This is a walk-in event. Come prepared to interview with our hiring managers.



Job Requirements

Requirements:

  • Must have a Texas Level II Security License in hand
  • Must have a Valid Driver’s License and clean driving record
  • 2 Years of Unarmed Security experience preferred
  • 2 Years of Customer Service experience.
  • Must have reliable transportation to and from work.
  • Must have open availability to work any day including weekends and holidays as needed and willing to work overtime as required.
  • Must be comfortable working outside for extended durations and in various environmental conditions.
  • Must be able to perform physically demanding tasks in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.
  • Must regularly walk or stand for extended periods of time and distance.

A Security Officer may perform a multitude of duties as specified by the Post Orders and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). The Security Officer will read and become extremely knowledgeable of Post Orders and SOP and will be able to act quickly and efficiently according to such directives. 



Benefits

Industry-leading employee benefits that include weekly pay, 401k savings plan with a company match, affordable medical, dental & vision benefits, employee referral bonuses, paid time off, premium holiday pay, tuition reimbursement, and more – available for qualified candidates!

jobs.title: Event Management Intern - Event Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Event Management Intern – Event Operations

Location: Houston, TX – Toyota Center
Company: BEST Crowd Management
Duration: 2026 Internship
Compensation: Paid Internship ($7.25 / hr for office hours & $15.00 / hr on Event Days)

About BEST Crowd Management:

BEST Crowd Management is a nationwide leader in event security and guest services, providing operational excellence at some of the most high-profile stadiums, arenas, and entertainment venues in the country.

Internship Overview:

BEST Crowd Management is seeking motivated Event Management Interns to gain hands-on experience in Event Security & Guest Services Operations at major stadiums and arenas. This role is designed for students or recent graduates looking to develop leadership skills in large-scale event operations, crowd management, and venue security. Interns will be actively involved in gameday execution, staffing logistics, and operational planning.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the hiring, scheduling, and payroll management for event security and guest services staff.

  • Support the set-up and breakdown of event operations, ensuring all logistics align with security and crowd management plans.

  • Help lead gameday operations, including deployment of staff, troubleshooting issues, and working frontline roles as needed.

  • Conduct onboarding and training for new event staff.

  • Collaborate with stadium and arena leadership teams to ensure operational efficiency.

  • Participate in post-event evaluations and reports to improve future operations.

  • Gain exposure to venue security protocols, emergency response plans, and crowd control strategies.

  • Provide hands-on support in various departments to gain a 360-degree view of event management.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Sports Management, Hospitality, Business, Criminal Justice, or a related field.

  • Passion for live events, sports, and large-scale operations.

  • Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to problem-solve in fast-paced environments.

  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as required for events.

  • Willingness to work in both operational and administrative roles, gaining well-rounded experience.

  • Comfortable working outdoors and in various weather conditions.

What You’ll Gain:

  • Hands-on experience in stadium and arena operations at major venues.

  • Mentorship from industry leaders in event security and crowd management.

  • Networking opportunities within the sports and live event industry.

  • A chance to be part of high-energy events, from professional sports games to concerts and special events.

How to Apply:

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter detailing their interest in event operations and relevant experience.

It is the policy of BEST Crowd Management to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, or disability in accordance with applicable federal laws. In addition, BEST Crowd Management complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment including, but not limited to hiring, placement, assignment, promotion, termination, layoffs, recalls, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. It is also the policy of BEST Crowd Management not to honor requests that employees be assigned on the basis of sex or any other classification protected by law, unless such request is based on a bona fide occupational qualification for that assignment.

Communication Skills, Criminal Justice, Emergency Planning, Emergency Response, Event Management, Hospitality and Tourism, Identify Issues, Leadership, Logistics, Mentoring, Operational Improvement, Operations Management, Operations Planning, Payroll Management, Problem Solving Skills, Protective Services, Security Monitoring, Security Protocols, Sports, Sports Management

jobs.title: Event Services Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Kick off your exciting career in Event Security with Allied Universal® Event Services, the go-to leader in crowd management and event staffing. Dive into the action at sports stadiums, concerts, festivals, and convention centers, and thrive on the energy of being where it all happens. Join a lively team that services thousands of venues each year, ensuring safety and fun for everyone. Enjoy the perks of flexible part-time work that fits your lifestyle—ideal for students, retirees, or anyone seeking a dynamic job. We offer job opportunities in event staff, security, and operations. Join our welcoming, collaborative, and innovative team, and benefit from a range of perks depending on your role and hours. At Allied Universal®, every day brings a new adventure. Ready to make your mark in the event industry? Join us and be part of the excitement!



Allied Universal Event Services® is hiring a Client Account Manager assigned to the University of Houston account. This position is responsible for the day-to-day operations and overseeing events at an assigned account. Account managers also build, improve, and maintain relationships with clients and employees, develop and retain staff, and coordinate needed support services and solve problems to effectively run the account and event operations. Through knowledge of the principles and practices used in successful event management, this position is responsible for show preparation up and through its closeout, while adhering to all applicable policies and procedures. Duties include the provisioning of leadership and direction to subordinate staff, supervisors, and front-line crew members while maintaining the highest levels of employee morale, safety, service, appearance, and performance.

Must have a minimum of (3) years of security, guest services and/or venue management experience in major collegiate athletics, professional sports or large entertainment venues. Salary is negotiable dependent on experience. Relocation assistance offered.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Supervise the day-to-day event operations and staffing of an assigned client site
  • Manage a team of event supervisors and event staff including hiring/selection, scheduling, payroll, training, coaching, development and support, discipline, and terminations
  • Build, improve, and maintain effective relationships with both client and employees
  • Coordinate necessary support services to effectively manage client site to meet or exceed financial and operational goals and provide quality customer service
  • Ensure all required reporting and contract compliance requirements are met
  • Assure regular communication of issues or event with our client
  • Handle any escalated security issues or emergency situations appropriately
  • Communicate staffing needs via Requisition Form; assist recruiters in identifying, interviewing, and hiring quality candidates
  • Develop staff in both technical and professional skills through performance management (coaching, counseling, disciplining, training, annual formal performance evaluations, recognition, etc.)
  • Assure communication of policies, company announcements and job openings through a consistently updated READ file at each site
  • Meet all contractual scheduled hours with a minimum of unbilled overtime
  • Coordinate and/or conduct site-specific OJT, client-specific training, and annual refresher training for event security and event staff personnel, as well as meet Allied Universal’s corporate training standards
  • Develop and maintain operational procedures so that a valid, site-specific post orders are always available for emergency reference by the event staff
  • Manage uniforms, equipment, supplies, and vehicles utilized at the account(s), maintaining appropriate inventories and maintenance checklists
  • Take a proactive role in communicating with the client and meeting their needs; meet regularly, listen to issues, provide security and technical expertise and solutions; ensure complete customer satisfaction
  • Capably utilize ABI and WinTeam for scheduling and billing, and to produce reports (such as Scheduling Activity, invoice Aging by tiers, Training Summary and Training Detail reports) that require interpretation and action for effective business management
  • Enforce Allied Universal Event Services policies as outlined in the handbooks, executive memos and on the portal
  • Attend client meetings, security meetings, and event walk-through(s)
  • Ensure all staff is debriefed properly and prepared for each event
  • Prepare and disseminate event post orders to each employee working each event as assigned venue/event
  • Ensure all labor laws are being adhered to (rest and meal periods executed per law, check-in/check-out procedure is followed, etc.)
  • Promote Grooming and Appearance Policy by looking professional and appropriate at all times and enforcing that policy within the ranks
  • Maintain constant communication with direct manager regarding client issues or concerns, employee performance issues, guest complaints, injuries, or other important facts related to account/event assigned
  • Create venue dot maps deployment sheets, show grids, etc.
  • Complete and submit all paperwork (incident reports, workers compensation filings, etc.) according to policy, along with the event file, to direct manager
  • Oversee and maintain Core staffing, key position succession, and monitor scheduled personnel/shifts
  • Facilitate the timely invoicing of events and follows up with client to ensure payment; investigate and mitigate any impediments to the invoicing and payment process in conjunction with the Finance Manager

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
  • Minimum of three (3) years of event management, event operations, and/or event supervisory experience
  • Experience in hiring, developing, motivating, and retaining quality staff
  • Ability to develop and grow customer relationships
  • Ability to work in a team-oriented management environment with the ability to work independently
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, complex situations, a diverse team of employees and client requirements on an ongoing basis
  • Ability to work in a team-oriented management environment while having an entrepreneurial attitude
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, successfully handle and prioritize multiple competing assignments and effectively manage deadlines
  • Highly proficient and fully functional in all Microsoft Office applications and able to effectively utilize all available office management technology
  • Professional, articulate, and able to use good independent judgment and discretion
  • Must be able to work nights/evenings/holidays as needed with a flexible schedule
  • Previous payroll, billing, and scheduling experience

BENEFITS:

  • Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, and disability insurance
  • Enrollment in our company’s 401(k)plan, subject to eligibility requirements
  • Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days
  • Vacation time offered at an accrual rate of 3.08 hours biweekly. Unused vacation is only paid out where required by law.

jobs.title: Houston Event Staff & Security - Now Hiring!
jobs.description:
5 STAR Event Services is a leading provider of event security and staffing solutions, specializing in the sports and entertainment industries. Since its inception in 2000, the company has built a strong reputation by delivering exceptional service at over 42,000 events across Houston, Austin, and San Antonio, Texas. As a woman-owned business and a privately held enterprise, 5 STAR has carved out a distinctive niche by offering reliable, professional, and flexible event staffing that ensures both safety and enjoyment for all participants. They actively support a wide range of events including Major League Soccer (MLS) and National Women's Soccer League (NWSL) games, NCAA football matches, NASCAR and Formula 1 races, MotoGP events, AHL hockey, G League basketball, as well as concerts, theatrical performances, symphonies, festivals, and conventions. At 5 STAR Event Services, the focus is on creating a secure and welcoming environment for all guests, with a dedicated team that emphasizes safety, professionalism, and excellent customer service. Employees enjoy the opportunity to work in energetic, fast-paced environments that vary from indoor arenas to outdoor venues regardless of weather conditions, which provides a dynamic and fulfilling work experience. The company values teamwork through its motto "Together Everyone Achieves More," fostering a sense of connection among the guest services staff and security officers. The opportunity to join the guest services team as an Event Staff or Security Officer at 5 STAR Event Services offers permanent part-time, hourly employment with a starting pay range of $13.00 and up per hour. This role is especially appealing to those who thrive in vibrant community and public event settings and who are looking for flexible schedules that can accommodate evening and weekend work. The position involves a variety of responsibilities centered around maintaining the safety, security, and comfort of guests, clients, and fellow employees at sporting and music events. As a member of the 5 STAR team, employees are expected to uphold and enforce the integrity of public and private event areas by monitoring entry and exit points, conducting routine inspections such as bag checks and credential verifications, and providing directions and assistance to event patrons. Maintaining clear access routes for attendees and vehicles, managing complaints in adherence to company policies, and supporting orderly evacuation procedures during emergencies are also essential functions. Additionally, employees provide security escorts when required, contributing to the overall safety and smooth operation of large-scale events. The role demands individuals who possess a high school diploma or GED equivalent, are at least 18 years of age, and have reliable communication and transportation means. A Level 2 Security License is a mandatory requirement; however, the company offers Level II training and examination at no cost to applicants, who must pass an exam, submit to fingerprinting, and undergo a criminal background check to qualify. Strong customer service skills, effective communication abilities, a professional appearance, and the aptitude to stay calm in high-pressure scenarios are key attributes sought in candidates. Physical demands of the job include the ability to walk, stand for extended periods, stoop, kneel, crouch, and lift up to 25 pounds, while operating in potentially noisy and crowded environments such as loud athletic and musical events. 5 STAR ensures employee comfort by providing necessary accommodations like earplugs, tents, rain ponchos, and water, especially for outdoor venues that operate rain or shine. The varied work environment and events calendar present a unique opportunity for people who are enthusiastic about engaging with their community and city, enhancing their skill set in security and customer service, and having fun along the way. Joining 5 STAR Event Services means becoming a part of an organization that values its employees, offers competitive pay, and provides consistent event work year-round rather than seasonal temp jobs. The company’s commitment to Equal Opportunity Employment and status as a DPS licensed security provider reinforces its professionalism and dedication to quality in the industry. Prospective applicants are encouraged to visit the company’s official website to view current event calendars and learn more about the exciting career opportunities available with 5 STAR Event Services.
  • High school diploma or GED equivalent
  • At least 18 years of age
  • Reliable forms of communication and transportation
  • Level 2 security license with Level II training and exam provided
  • Ability to pass exam, submit to fingerprinting and criminal background check
  • Ability to walk and stand for extended periods
  • Ability to lift 25lbs
  • Full physical and mental dexterity
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch, hear, see and speak English clearly
